title: Tech Note: Updating Custom PHP Libraries used by 4D
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The note is tied to 4D's bundled PHP 7.3 FastCGI interpreter used by commands like PHP Execute; PHP interop in 4D is a long-lived but niche feature, and the specific PHP version/build instructions here are now outdated since 4D has since bundled newer PHP releases and the underlying OS toolchains (Xcode/Visual Studio versions) referenced have moved on substantially.
related_updates: 4D has continued to update its bundled PHP engine version over subsequent releases, obsoleting the specific PHP 7.3 build steps and Visual Studio 2015/2017 toolchain guidance here

the core technique of building a custom PHP engine with FastCGI support and swapping in php-fcgi-4d is still conceptually applicable, but exact commands/compiler versions must be adapted to the current 4D/PHP version pairing
